KokoroSharp and MisakiSharp: MIT; license texts are in licenses.
https://github.com/Lyrcaxis/KokoroSharp
https://github.com/Lyrcaxis/MisakiSharp

Kokoro 82M model and bundled British voice arrays: Apache License 2.0.
Model/voice source: https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
Neural model download: https://github.com/Lyrcaxis/KokoroSharpBinaries
The model weight file is downloaded separately, not included in this ZIP.

Microsoft ONNX Runtime: MIT; license text is in licenses.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

Ollama and Qwen3 are separate installations/downloads, not bundled here.
https://github.com/ollama/ollama
https://ollama.com/library/qwen3:8b

This project integrates these components for local desktop conversation/speech.
The synthetic voice is not a recording or clone of an Avengers performer.
